messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — Northbound POC kickoff today 14:00 PT. Draft agenda below + a few open asks. Can we do a 13:00 sync for final alignment?

Jordan: I can make 13:00. Paste the agenda + initial success criteria here so I can prep infra notes. Also what's their expected concurrency / SLA?

Sam: Agenda (proposed):
1) Intros & stakeholders (who from their side)
2) Use cases + priority flows
3) Prompts/evals we’ll run (owner + sample size)
4) Infra recommendation (Hosted vs Dedicated) + network plan
5) Security questionnaire & data-flow diagram review
6) Pricing & pilot credits discussion
7) Timeline / go-no-go criteria / next steps

Success criteria (draft): 95th-pct latency < 250ms for chat on target concurrency, human-labeled accuracy >= 85% on prioritized eval set, hallucination < 5% on safety prompts, and pilot TCO within the target cost band (TBD).

Ana: Quick notes on evals — ask customer for: 1) 30–100 labeled prompts per priority use case; 2) expected utterance lengths; 3) examples of failure modes. I can run a baseline run and share a small harness. We should measure: accuracy, instruction-following, hallucination rate, mean latency, and token cost per convo.

Jordan: For infra: recommend starting on Hosted API for fastest time-to-value. If they require predictable tail latency / isolated data, spin up Dedicated guidance (GPU pool sizing). We'll prepare both cost estimates and a fall-back routing plan. We'll also enable prefix/KV caching for repeated support prompts to save cost.

Sam: Two sales asks: customer asked about enterprise discounts and pilot credits. I can propose a 3-month pilot credit; need finance approval if > $25k. Also they want a rough cost estimate per 1M tokens under Hosted vs Dedicated — Jordan can you draft quick numbers before 13:00?

Marta: Security checklist (quick):
- Which deployment: Hosted (no peering) or VPC/Private (peering required)?
- If VPC: CIDR ranges, AWS account IDs, contact for network config.
- Data classification: any PHI/PII? retention requirements?
- Required logs/SIEM integration (syslog endpoint or S3 export).
- Required certifications (SOC2, ISO27001, any additional attestation).
I’ll own filling out their questionnaire but need the items above and the contact on their SecOps side.

Sam: I'll ask Northbound for: prompts+labels, any sample data, network info, and the security contact. Also cc'ing them on the invite so they can drop artifacts prior to the call.

Ana: Eval template (mini) to request from them — you can paste into the email:```
- use_case: support escalation triage
- prompt_count: 50 (20 high-priority, 30 medium)
- labels: recommended binary correctness + free-text rationale
- success_metrics: accuracy >= 0.85, hallucination <= 0.05
```
(we can tweak counts after they share.)

Jordan: I’ll prep infra checklist & two cost scenarios (Hosted baseline, Dedicated reserved pool). Will include a quick runbook for failover to a cheaper model if tail latency spikes.

Sam: One more blocker to surface: legal flagged data residency for EU customers — Northbound mentioned some EU users. If they need EU-only processing, we need to confirm region availability or propose Private deployment. @Marta please flag any policy gaps.

Marta: Noted. If EU-only is required we need a Private or Dedicated in the EU region and confirmation on key management (customer KMS vs Redwood). Also forward any data residency clauses from their contract team.

Sam: Good. Action items before 13:00 sync:
- Sam: request prompts, network info, security contact, contract excerpts (data residency) — email sent now.
- Jordan: draft Hosted vs Dedicated cost scenarios + tail-latency notes.
- Ana: attach eval harness + sample template to the invite.
- Marta: prepare initial answers for questionnaire + list of items we need from them.

deploy-bot: Meeting invite created: "Northbound POC kickoff" 14:00 PT — calendar invites sent to listed participants. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks all — if any blockers surface before the 13:00 sync call, drop them here. I'll consolidate and update the agenda.

Jordan: LGTM. See you at 13:00.

Ana: Cool — prepping the eval harness now.

Marta: I'll draft the questionnaire answers and a network diagram template to share in the thread.
